about.text: The fat left in whey, spun off in a separator: a cream of usually 25–30 % fat, against about 40 % for milk cream. It can go back into the cheese milk, or be churned into whey butter.

links.name: Tetra Pak Dairy Processing Handbook, ch. Whey processing

how.text: A whey separator spins the cheese fat that escaped the vat out of the whey. It is also what defatting for WPC needs. Separation temperature is not given in the pages opened.

links.name: Tetra Pak Dairy Processing Handbook, ch. 18 Milk and whey fractionation
